methods.description: Use nonzero-frequency extremes for range and data values with greatest frequency for mode; recognise tied modes or uniform no mode.
Use sumf for number of observations and sumfx for total; divide sumfx bysumf including zero-score observations.
Use cumulative counts to locate middle rank; average both middle scores for even datasets, not middle table row.
Recover frequencies from adjacent cumulative totals before summary calculation.
Read half total to ogive for ungrouped data then check central score against cumulative counts.
